<!--
PURPOSE
  Step-by-step walkthrough so YOU load and inspect the GENE14 hooke DACT data by
  hand and understand each object before producing the Phase-3 Key Results.

  Reference how-to:  HOWTO_load_and_group.md   (in this same folder)
  loaf template:     software/loaf/inst/examples/loaf_example_pbx.Rmd

THE THREE KEY RESULTS (what we're building toward)
  KR1  Mutant phenotype vs control       e.g. cep290_High_to_Low vs ctrl (negsib)
  KR2  Mutant phenotype vs phenotype     e.g. cep290_High_to_Low vs cep290_Low_to_High
  KR3  Transcriptional similarity        (a) shared DACT set across phenotypes
                                         (b) PCA, one point per embryo's DACT vector

IMPORTANT — WHAT IS ALREADY DONE (so you don't redo heavy work)
  * The CDS is ALREADY FIT (hooke v3.1.0). Do NOT re-fit for plots.
  * The DACT contrasts are ALREADY COMPUTED and live in:
        output/phenosplit_contrasts_all.tsv
    Its `contrast` column already contains every pairing KR1 & KR2 ask for:
        KR1 (vs control):  *_vs_ctrl   (cep290_High_to_Low_vs_ctrl, b9d2_CE_vs_ctrl, ...)
        KR2 (pheno-pheno): *_vs_*      (cep290_High_to_Low_vs_Low_to_High, b9d2_CE_vs_HTA)
    So KR1 & KR2 are FILTER-AND-READ problems, not fitting problems.
  * The 7.3G BPCells CDS load (HOWTO §1) OOM-kills the login node. You only need
    it if you want to derive per-embryo vectors from scratch. For KR3 the
    per-embryo tables are ALREADY exported:
        output/embryo_celltype_counts.tsv     (raw counts, embryo x cell_type)
        output/embryo_celltype_fraction.tsv   (fractions)
        output/embryo_pca_dact_subset.tsv     (PCA restricted to shared-DACT cell types)
    Start from those; only touch the CDS on the grid if these are insufficient.

  Because of this, the sections below are ordered:
    A. environment + column-sanity checks (no CDS)
    B. KR1 / KR2 directly from phenosplit_contrasts_all.tsv
    C. KR3 from the exported per-embryo tables
    D. (OPTIONAL, GRID ONLY) load the CDS the HOWTO way, if you must re-derive
-->
